summary: Vodafone Group Plc filed a Form 6-K furnishing a UK TR-1 major-holdings notification dated 7 October 2026; the disclosing party is Societe Generale, not the issuer acting strategically. Societe Generale reported crossing below the 9% threshold on 5 October 2026, holding 2,076,272,297 direct voting rights (8.962098%) plus 4,441,928 via cash-settled financial instruments (0.019173%), totalling 8.981271% (2,080,714,225 votes), down from 9.010091%. No board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms are stated; the filing is a routine Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules disclosure, equivalent to a US Schedule 13G/13D threshold update, with no risk-arb angle.
